name: Haircare product routines and sponsored hair ads
what_it_is: Videos show people demonstrating hair-care routines and reviewing or promoting shampoo, conditioner, oil and styling products — from a Brazilian "bleach to blonde" transformation and a straight-to-curly styling skit to sponsored wash-day routines for Pantene and OGX and a large product haul. Several are brand ads or marketplace recommendations (Wildberries, Nice One) rather than reactions to a single event.
